result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and overhead traffic signals. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median refuge or visible pedestrian signals create a car-oriented environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a central refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walk/don't walk signals are visible to guide crossing timing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and shorten the effective crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve predictability for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps with tactile paving, and pedestrian signals. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and the wide corner radius may encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and right side of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the intersection in the center foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using a continental or ladder pattern to increase visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide suburban intersection with a marked continental crosswalk and traffic signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance across multiple lanes without a refuge island increases pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or island for pedestrians to wait safely if they cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and reduce effective crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, sidewalks, and traffic signals within a residential neighborhood. However, the wide roadway geometry and lack of physical traffic calming measures result in significant exposure for pedestrians during crossings.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white van parked near the intersection corner may block the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, adjacent to the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection corners to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.
